greeting.title: Hi, I'm Clippy!
greeting.body: I know my way around Mumcord. Want a quick tour? It takes about a minute. If not now, you'll find me in Settings → About → Tips.

servers.title: Your servers
servers.body: The bar on the far left holds your servers. Add one with +, or find public servers with the magnifying glass. You can stay connected to several servers at once.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Double-click a channel to join it for voice. A single click shows its chat without joining, and Follow keeps you posted about it.

talk.title: How you talk
talk.body: Push-to-talk or voice activation? Choose in Settings → Voice & Audio. Push-to-talk also works with mouse buttons.

panel.title: Your user panel
panel.body: Bottom left you mute your microphone, deafen, turn your camera on or hang up. The small arrows next to them open more choices.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Press {{key}} to find people and channels, even on big servers.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Reply to a message, quote it, @mention people and share pictures and files. The formatting buttons appear while you type.

apps.title: Apps
apps.body: The Apps button in the message bar starts a screen share, a watch party or your camera. Plugins add more.

themes.title: Your look
themes.body: Settings → Appearance has themes in dark and light. A server can get its own: right-click it and choose Theme.

end.title: That's it!
end.body: Have fun on Mumcord. You can call me back any time in Settings → About → Tips.
